name: KIC 7125569
description: Reference star of the red-giant-branch (RGB) granulation-radius relations (Larsen et al. in prep.).
provenance: Stan MCMC draws from calibration/derive_relations.py (4 chains x 2000 draws) on 4000 Kepler RGB stars with numax > 2.5 muHz. Teff, [Fe/H] and radius of the reference star from APOKASC-3 (Pinsonneault et al. 2025); amp/charb are posterior medians of its own Kepler-bolometric-corrected granulation observables.
